title: Ship a review control widget contract with thumbs mode, reason codes and a submit event
description:
Generalize trace-ui/src/components/labeling-review.tsx into an embeddable review control (export path cyclotron/components/review-control). Props: itemId, decision {decisionId, label, confidence, classes, version}, reviewReason?, mode 'thumbs'|'labels', positiveLabel, reasons? [{code, label, labelEffect 'exclude'|'none'}], value?, disabled, compact. Events: onReview({itemId, decisionId, label, reasonCode, explanation}), onUndo({itemId, decisionId}). It never calls a server. Ordering: after the status shape (shares types).

Acceptance criteria:
- Thumbs up maps to positiveLabel; thumbs down requires a reason when reasons are given; a reason with labelEffect 'none' submits no label.
- The decision and confidence are visible before the reviewer chooses, and the control says it was shown before the review.
- Keyboard and screen-reader use pass the existing Vitest accessibility checks; UI strings use review, label, explanation, decision, confidence.
- The console's MultiLabelCard uses the new control, so there is one implementation.

comments.author: home
comments.text: Landed on feat/review-control (stacked on feat/review-rate-state): trace-ui/src/components/review-control.tsx, exported as cyclotron/components/review-control. Thumbs mode (two classes, positiveLabel maps thumbs up) or one button per class; application reason codes with noLabel for reviews without a label; explanation; onReview({itemId, decisionId, label, reasonCode, explanation}) and onUndo; recorded reviews read-only. Data-only; a spec asserts no fetch. Corrections are marked with a check or cross mark and a sentence, not colour alone. Styles for ReviewControl and LabelingReview now live in styles/shared.css (moved out of the console's index.css). Not done here: MultiLabelCard still uses LabelingReview.

comments.author: home
comments.text: Ryan, 2026-10-09: thumbs stay configurable; per-class buttons are the general case. Applications choose the mode per cyclotron (Papyrus: thumbs for include/exclude relevance, per-class otherwise). Reason presets are not generalized: the control must work with no reasons at all; applications pass only their own existing codes.
